name: docker
description: /docker:docker routes to /docker:create or /docker:tune, which share private sub-skills. /docker:create builds the dev environment (hot reload) and the prod environment (lean image in ./deploy). /docker:tune brings an existing setup to the rules and optimizes it with measurements. Images use the newest version and nginx uses HTTP/2 and HTTP/3. Hooks enforce project, service and container names, host UID/GID in dev, volumes in a local folder, one .env per environment, defaults, dockerignore and HTTP/3.
